statement: For any prescribed positive integer a coprime to three, an explicit artificial unit-supported ternary density U has initial row (0,1,1), positive values exactly on unit cylinders, mean one over unit cylinders, exact parent/child coherence, and uniform refinement error at most 3^(1-l) after level l>=1, but its values along a at levels d+1 are 3^(-d) and have sum 3/2. The normalization V obtained by multiplying by the initial digit has row (0,1,2), mean one over all cylinders, coherent refinement with error at most 2*3^(1-l), and selected-path series sum (a mod 3)*3/2. This refutes deduction of fixed-root divergence from these general properties alone. These are not the actual Collatz densities: Lean checks U<=4/3 while the actual signed unit coefficient at depth one is >=3/2 at plus target 17 and minus target 1. No actual coefficient divergence, Juggler estimate or termination result follows. Kernel-checked; independent review and advisory statement coverage pending.
